translations.web: You have perseverance and have endured for my name’s sake, and have not grown weary.
translations.bsb: Without growing weary, you have persevered and endured many things for the sake of My name.
translations.kjv: And hast borne, and hast patience, and for my name's sake hast laboured, and hast not fainted.
translations.asv: and thou hast patience and didst bear for my name's sake, and hast not grown weary.
